harness.core: Run21Core.sol: engine-neutral, no cheatcodes; core = owner + authorized keeper + NFT buyer; R21Actor contracts = donor, swapper, skimmer, unprivileged attacker
harness.realism: real NFTMinterV2 with pooler registered at index 4 (3 placeholder dispatchers at 1-3); MockUniV2AmmPair/Router/Factory from test/mocks (story-051: balance-(reserve-out) swap crediting, balance-reserve mint, no feeTo); MockERC4626 1:1 sUSDS; PSM donation disabled (batchMinter unset)
harness.seededState: pair seeded 1,000,000/1,050,000 (suite A, sUSDS=token0) or 20,000/2,000 (suite B, sUSDS=token1, 10:1 skew); constructor runs two real index-4 mints and one quoted pool() so the pooler starts with nonzero LP and sUSDS
handlers: act_pool(aSeed, exact) [weighted x2; exact=quote floors, else 1-wei floors]
act_donate(side, amt up to 50% of pair balance, unsynced)
act_swap(dir, up to 30% of reserve, via router)
harness.nonVacuityGate: afterInvariant() asserts every run executed >=1 successful pool(), >=1 exact-quote-floor pool(), >=1 index-4 mint attempt; gate self-test with depth=2 FAILS as expected (forge-run21-vacuity-gate-selftest.log)

invariants.name: INV1_L25_noStrand
invariants.description: After any successful pool(), the residual sUSDS and phUSD from that zap are each <= (4 + 4*floor(rS/rP) + 4*floor(rP/rS))*(2 + a/r0) + a/1e12 wei (repo _dustTol, post reserves, pre-zap synced reserve, plus 1e-12 relative)
invariants.observed: max residual sUSDS 94 wei (suite B, 10:1 skew, a=5.57e22), 6 wei (suite A); phUSD residual 0 in every recorded worst case. Note: a flat '<=2 wei' bound is NOT achievable at skewed prices (price-scaled rounding); hence the repo-derived price-scaled bound.

invariants.name: INV1b_repoAbsoluteDustBound
invariants.description: Same as INV1 without the a/1e12 relative term

invariants.name: INV2_quoteExecuteConsistent
invariants.description: In the quote's state, pool(a, quote.phusdOut, quote.expectedLP) never reverts (any revert counted, InsufficientLP and router INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT named), and LP received (balance delta) >= quote.expectedLP for both exact and 1-wei floors

invariants.name: INV3_L21_hookGuard
invariants.description: hook == constructor default => index-4 mint via NFTMinterV2 reverts UniPoolerV2__HookNotSet with buyer USDS, pooler USDS/sUSDS/LP and NFT balance unchanged; hook != default => never reverts HookNotSet (and hooked mint never reverts)
invariants.note: A freshly deployed DefaultDispatchHook bypasses the guard and mints succeed (nMintOkFreshDefault>0). This is the documented, accepted escape hatch in story-051 (Design notes: 'Deliberate bypass ... Accepted'); requires a deliberate owner action, not filed.

invariants.name: INV4_lpNoLeak
invariants.description: Pooler-held LP never decreases between steps except by the owner-rescued amount, and balance >= sum(pooled LP) - sum(owner-rescued LP)

forge.note: Handlers wrap the target in try/catch, so selector-level reverts are 0 by design; inner success is enforced per run by the afterInvariant non-vacuity gate (passed in all 10,000 runs)

honesty: All passes are 'no counterexample in 1,000,000 forge calls (10,000 sequences) + 674,388 Medusa calls', NOT proofs. INV1/INV2 rounding behaviour is a candidate for symbolic-analyzer, but note memory: Halmos with 2+ symbolic divisions is intractable here (sqrt + several divisions).

tripwires.method: single-edit mutants generated by run21/gen-mutants.sh from work/src (== src @ 267660b) into work/test/run21/mutants/; src and work/src never edited (diff -rq clean)

tripwires.caveat: forge 1.5.1 shrinking reported 1-call sequences for M1/M2 that do NOT reproduce from fresh state (ghost-flag invariants; forge shrink artifact). Use the Medusa 2-call shrunk sequences and the deterministic Run21Replay.t.sol tripwires as the authoritative counterexamples.

summary: 0 failures on the real contract across all 4 requested invariants (+1 stricter diagnostic) under forge and Medusa; every invariant is falsified by at least one targeted mutant in both the campaign and a deterministic replay, so the passes are non-vacuous. No new findings. story-051 fixes for ycn20l21 (hook guard) and ycn20l24/L-25 (sync before sizing, balance-based quote) behave as specified under adversarial donation/skim/swap interleavings.
